summary: One Swabian Time Tagger card shared by the FLIM detector and scripts. Inputs are named by role; a negative channel number selects the falling edge of that input.

fields.label: Serial
fields.tip: Serial number of the card to open. null = the first card found.

fields.label: Simulation
fields.tip: Use the in-process mock instead of a card.

fields.label: Mock on failure
fields.tip: Fall back to the mock when the card cannot be opened. Only honoured while nidaq.simulation is also true; on a rig a missing card stays a hard error.

fields.label: Photons channel
fields.tip: Input carrying the single-photon detector pulses. Negative = falling edge (a SPAD's NIM pulse: -1).

fields.label: Photons trigger (V)
fields.tip: Trigger threshold. Inputs are 50 ohm; range +/-2.5 V.

fields.label: Photons dead time (ps)
fields.tip: Dead time on the photon input; 0 = the card's minimum. Set to the detector's own dead time against ringing and double counts.

fields.label: Laser sync channel
fields.tip: Input carrying the laser sync (TCSPC reference).

fields.label: Laser sync trigger (V)
fields.tip: Trigger threshold for the sync input.

fields.label: Line clock trigger (V)
fields.tip: An NI DO line drives about 1-1.5 V into the 50 ohm input: stay well below that.

fields.label: Line clock delay (ps)
fields.tip: Delay on the line (and frame) clock to align the Time Tagger image with the APD/PMT image. Positive when the galvo lags.

fields.label: Frame clock channel
fields.tip: Input carrying scan.frameStartClockLine, if cabled. Empty = not cabled.

fields.label: Frame clock trigger (V)
fields.tip: Trigger threshold for the frame clock input.

fields.label: STED pulse channel
fields.tip: Input carrying a photodiode on the STED beam, if cabled. Empty = not cabled.

fields.label: STED pulse trigger (V)
fields.tip: Trigger threshold for the STED photodiode input.

fields.label: Filter sync by photons
fields.tip: Enable the card's conditional filter: only the first laser sync after each photon is transmitted. Needed on a Time Tagger 20 or Ultra with a sync at tens of MHz. The TCSPC direction then reverses (start = photon, click = sync).

fields.label: Mock sample
fields.tip: What the mock card images (simulation only).

fields.label: Mock faults
fields.tip: Faults the mock reproduces for the debugging tutorials, e.g. {"missing_line_clock": true} or {"line_delay_ps": 1200} (simulation only).
